sloka: नीलाः किल पुरा बर्हा मयूराणां नराधिप ।सुराधिपाद्वरं प्राप्य गताः सर्वे ऽपि बर्हिणः ।। ७.१८.२५ ॥
transliteration: nīlāḥ kila purā barhā mayūrāṇāṁ narādhipa ।surādhipādvaraṁ prāpya gatāḥ sarve 'pi barhiṇaḥ ।। 7.18.25 ॥

translations.english: O king of men, it is said that formerly the feathers of peacocks were blue, and having obtained a boon from the lord of gods, all peacocks became (as they are now, with the characteristic 'eyes' on their feathers).
translations.hindi: इस पर वेदचती ने क्रोध में भर अपने हाथ से अपने बाल काट डाले । क्योंकि उस समय उसका हाथ तलवार रूप हो गया था
